title: ～に沿って
shortExplanation: Along with; in accordance with; following
longExplanation: The ～に沿って grammar point is used to express that something happens or is done along with, in accordance with, or following a particular line, path, or guideline. It is often used in instructions or explanations. The に沿って is attached to the noun representing the line, path or guideline.

examples.jp: 川に沿って歩いていくと、橋が見えてきます。
examples.romaji: Kawa ni sotte aruite iku to, hashi ga miete kimasu.
examples.en: If you walk along the river, you will see a bridge.

examples.jp: このレシピに沿って料理を作れば、間違いありません。
examples.romaji: Kono reshipi ni sotte ryouri wo tsukureba, machigai arimasen.
examples.en: If you cook according to this recipe, there will be no mistakes.

examples.jp: 規則に沿って行動しなければなりません。
examples.romaji: Kisoku ni sotte koudou shinakereba narimasen.
examples.en: We must act in accordance with the rules.

examples.jp: 山道に沿って進むと、小さな神社があります。
examples.romaji: Yamamichi ni sotte susumu to, chiisana jinja ga arimasu.
examples.en: If you follow the mountain path, there is a small shrine.
